user.title: Home Energy Advisor
user.description: Choose the household energy inputs. Local generation and battery are optional — without them, cost is calculated from grid import alone.

data_description.price_entity: The sensor giving the current import price per kWh.
data_description.currency: Currency for the cost sensors, e.g. EUR.
data_description.grid_import_entity: Cumulative energy imported from the grid.
data_description.grid_export_entity: Cumulative energy exported to the grid; used to work out how much generation you used yourself.
data_description.solar_entity: Cumulative local generation — solar, wind, hydro. Leave empty if you generate none.
data_description.battery_charge_entity: Cumulative energy charged into the battery.
data_description.battery_discharge_entity: Cumulative energy discharged from the battery.
data_description.house_consumption_entity: Total household consumption, if measured directly.

data_description.grid_export_entity: Cumulative energy exported to the grid; used to work out how much generation you used yourself.
data_description.solar_entity: Cumulative local generation — solar, wind, hydro. Leave empty if you generate none.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Energy Advisor is already configured; only one instance is needed.

cycles.title: Cycle totals
cycles.description: Choose which longer-period totals to create for every device. Daily and monthly totals are always created.

discover_devices.title: Discover devices to track
discover_devices.description: These energy and power sensors are not tracked yet. Select the ones to add as devices. Suggestions marked “may not be a device” often aren’t — a phone battery, a forecast — so add only what you recognise.

reset_totals.title: Reset all totals to zero
reset_totals.description: This starts every figure again from zero: energy, costs and savings for each device, the Untracked remainder and the whole home, along with their daily and monthly totals. The recorded history behind them is cleared too, so past periods can no longer be looked up. **This cannot be undone.** Your devices and settings are untouched, as is any helper you created yourself. Submit to reset, or go back to leave everything as it is.

abort.no_candidates: No untracked energy or power sensors were found to add.
abort.reset_totals_done: Every total has been reset to zero. Accounting continues from here.

user.title: Add a tracked device
user.description: Name the device and choose the one sensor that measures it — an energy counter, or a power sensor.

data_description.name: How this device appears in Home Assistant.
data_description.energy_entity: A cumulative energy sensor for this device.
data_description.power_entity: A power sensor; its energy is derived automatically.

reconfigure.title: Edit device
reconfigure.description: Change the device name or the sensor that measures it.

data_description.name: How this device appears in Home Assistant.
data_description.energy_entity: A cumulative energy sensor for this device.
data_description.power_entity: A power sensor; its energy is derived automatically.

error.select_one_sensor: Choose exactly one: an energy sensor or a power sensor, not both.
error.energy_not_total_increasing: This energy sensor must be a total-increasing counter. A net or measurement sensor would be misread as usage and inflate the cost.
error.power_not_measurement: This power sensor must report an instantaneous measurement. A total sensor cannot be integrated into energy correctly.

source_removed.title: An energy input is no longer available
source_removed.description: Home Energy Advisor can no longer find `{entity_id}`, which it needs for cost accounting — the entity may have been deleted or renamed. Edit the integration (or the device) to select the sensor again, so your figures stay accurate.

source_unavailable.title: An energy input has been unavailable for over an hour
source_unavailable.description: `{entity_id}` has been unavailable for more than an hour. Home Energy Advisor keeps accounting, but the energy and cost it would have measured while the sensor was down are missing. Check the device or integration that provides `{entity_id}`.

price_unavailable.title: The import price has been unavailable for over an hour
price_unavailable.description: The price sensor `{entity_id}` has been unavailable for more than an hour. Home Energy Advisor keeps pricing energy at the last price it saw, so costs during this period may be inaccurate. Check the tariff integration that provides the price.

source_never_reported.title: {name} is tracked by a sensor that has never reported
source_never_reported.description: `{entity_id}` has not produced a single reading since Home Energy Advisor started watching it, and there is none in the recorded history either. This is not a device that is simply switched off — that would still show its last reading. Until it is fixed, {name}'s energy and cost stay at zero and its share of the bill is counted under Untracked instead. Choose a different sensor for {name}, or check the integration that provides `{entity_id}`.

helper_recreated.title: A required helper was re-created
helper_recreated.description: Home Energy Advisor re-created a helper it needs to measure the energy of “{name}”. This helper is created automatically and “{name}” cannot be costed without it, so if you deleted it on purpose, remove the device from Home Energy Advisor instead.

cycle_helper_recreated.title: One or more cycle-total helpers were re-created
cycle_helper_recreated.description: Home Energy Advisor re-created one or more daily, monthly or longer-cycle total helpers that had been deleted. These provide the per-period totals; to stop creating a longer cycle, turn it off in the integration options rather than deleting its helpers.

implausible_source.title: “{name}” is reporting more energy than the whole house
implausible_source.description: For over an hour, the sensor measuring “{name}” has reported using more energy than your entire home consumed — which no single device can do. Home Energy Advisor has stopped counting it, so it no longer distorts your other devices' figures, and will start again by itself once the readings make sense. This almost always means the sensor is faulty rather than the appliance: check whether the device offers another energy sensor and select that one instead. Figures recorded in the hour before this was detected are still affected; you can clear them with the “Reset totals” action.

negative_remainder.title: Tracked devices are drawing more than the house consumes
negative_remainder.description: For over an hour, the energy attributed to your tracked devices has exceeded the household total. This usually means a device sensor is double-counted, or a house-level input is wrong. The Untracked figure is held at zero so costs still add up, but check your device and house-level sensor selections.

reset_totals.name: Reset totals
reset_totals.description: Starts every Home Energy Advisor figure again from zero and clears the recorded history behind them. Cannot be undone.

config_entry_id.name: Household
config_entry_id.description: The Home Energy Advisor configuration whose totals to reset.

reset_unknown_entry.message: No Home Energy Advisor configuration was found with the id {entry_id}.

reset_entry_not_loaded.message: That Home Energy Advisor configuration is not loaded, so its totals cannot be reset. Try again once it has started.
